findings.problem: Deployed legacy admin_update_all_profiles permits owners to update their own role and billing fields; permissive policies OR together, bypassing the stricter policy. API key update policies also bypass immutable-field checks, and api_usage permits public INSERT.
findings.status: Migration prepared and verified locally; not applied remotely
findings.evidence: Read-only pg_policies inspection of the deployed database, followed by reproducing owner-to-admin escalation in disposable PostgreSQL using the observed policy combination. Twenty post-fix tests cover protected fields, normal profile saves, multi-key revocation, admin operations, service writes, email sync, and forged usage.

findings.problem: Six deployed edge functions reject the existing preview origin via CORS by returning Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://www.aidotnet.dev to requests from https://test.aidotnet.dev.
findings.status: Deployed minimal CORS wrapper to six existing handlers; preflight verified and community registration passed against preview
findings.evidence: Read-only OPTIONS checks against billing-portal, delete-account, register-community-license, issue-license, admin-resend-license-email, and validate-license. Regression tests cover preflight and actual error responses, production and preview origins, rejected lookalikes, and concurrent request isolation.

findings.problem: Login accepted external redirect destinations; callback path checks allowed backslash/control-character origin escapes.
findings.status: Deployed to preview and browser regressions passed

findings.problem: An unpaid Checkout completion granted entitlements; checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded was ignored.
findings.remaining: The deployed Stripe endpoint must subscribe to checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded. The handler tests use boundary doubles, not live Stripe or a database.

findings.problem: Crawler handlers leaked across passes; request emission and unsuccessful clipboard operations could count as success; unexplored visible controls could be silently omitted.
findings.status: Fixed coverage gates, duplicate-row replay, nested-state tracking and destination readiness; six local regressions and all five hosted desktop/phone persona crawls pass.
findings.remaining: Template sampling remains explicit. Phone crawls now re-exercise shared controls with a real mobile device context. Real business outcomes are asserted separately.

findings.problem: The docs root depended on a Vercel redirect and produced an empty delayed-redirect document on static previews.
findings.status: Deployed to preview and browser check passed

findings.problem: The existing type-check script lacked dependencies; frontend null/DOM type errors and a type-only import prevented a clean check.
findings.status: Fixed; current preview build reports zero frontend errors and warnings.
findings.remaining: Deno edge functions require separate runtime/type verification; they are not checked by the browser/Node tsconfig.

findings.problem: Navigation tests hard-coded the production hostname, sampled links, and raced asynchronous auth redirects. Some tests silently passed when expected controls were absent.
findings.status: fixed for navigation, landing CTA, and landing internal links

findings.problem: The phone license header overflow widened the layout viewport and made lower modal controls untappable.
findings.status: Fixed and deployed to preview; strengthened phone regression and the final hosted main/admin jobs passed.

findings.problem: Unversioned E2E Stripe responses moved current_period_end away from the subscription, causing a false cancellation failure.
findings.status: E2E API version now matches billing-portal; all 11 real billing journeys passed.

findings.problem: URL assertions returned while the login destination was still interactive and CSS was pending, causing false visible-desktop-control findings in phone crawls.
findings.status: Fixed; delayed-stylesheet regression reproduced the old failure and passes after the fix. All six final hosted jobs passed.

findings.problem: The account menu waited for an asynchronous admin-role lookup before attaching its handlers, so early clicks did nothing.
findings.status: Fixed and deployed to preview; a regression holds the role response pending and verifies that the menu and sign-out control still work.

integration_requirements: Apply the reviewed RLS migration and unpaid-Checkout handler correction in a controlled backend release; neither has been applied remotely.
Mailbox receipt, a settled Stripe test-mode payment, and third-party OAuth consent remain outside the current generated-link, signed-event, card-free trial and provider-handoff checks.
known_test_substitutions: Preview billing tests simulate Supabase responses and do not validate database policies or edge-function deployment.
Webhook tests execute the real handler with Stripe, database, and mail boundary doubles; signature cryptography, SQL semantics, and network delivery are outside their scope.
Existing new-customer journey injects a signed checkout event instead of completing a payment.
Existing account-billing upgrade journey changes the plan through Stripe's API after asserting the portal asks for a card.
Existing admin crawler stubs writes; dedicated integration tests must prove persistence.
A passing test count is not a claim that every possible user state or path was exercised.
